newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Riopesca buys out Triton Fisheries.
newsitem.headline: Greek Riopesca buys out Triton Fisheries.

text.p: Selonda Aquaculture subsidiary Riopesca said on Thursday that it acquired the remaining 20 percent stake in Triton Fisheries and now owns 100 percent of the hatchery.
Triton Fisheries will complete its new hatchery facility in Thesprotia in the first half of the year, financed by subsidies of 280 million drachmas by the European Union.
Riopesca management expects the new third generation hatchery to commence fry production in the second half of 1997.

This year it expects to double its output to 35 million fry while it will start fish farming of Sargus sargus following last year's successful pilot project which put out 13 tonnes of farmed Sargus sargus.
The fish was warmly received by consumers of Mediterranean fish species, it said.
Riopesca forecast sales will reach 3.2 billion drachmas this year and sees pretax profit exceeding 1.2 billion.
